name: omarchy-theme-manager
description: Quality tooling for the Omarchy Theme Manager plugin.

scripts.lint:qml: /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint -i /usr/share/omarchy/shell/Commons/qmldir -i /usr/share/omarchy/shell/Ui/qmldir ImagePicker.qml ThemeManagerController.qml ThemeCatalogController.qml ImagePickerModel.js ThemeManagerModel.js ThemeCatalogModel.js
scripts.lint:shell: shellcheck list.sh catalog.sh theme-inventory.sh && shfmt -d -i 2 -ci -bn list.sh catalog.sh theme-inventory.sh
scripts.quality: npm run test && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:qml && npm run format:check && npm run validate
